regions.region: page 13 left column below Scheme 40, continuation of section 8
regions.finding: The review states that low temperature limits racemization, aryl-substituted 2,3-allenoates may be inaccessible, and fully substituted (E)-enol triflates give trisubstituted allenoates with low conversion and enantioselectivity. The actual low-performance fully substituted case is retained qualitatively; the speculative aryl limitation is not fabricated as a zero-yield run.

regions.region: page 13 conclusions, acknowledgements, and beginning of references 1–4
regions.finding: Conclusions and future-work discussion refer back to earlier schemes and reaction classes but add no new uniquely specified experiment, table row, arrow, or quantitative outcome. Acknowledgements and references are non-experimental context.

All complex structures and stereochemical assignments remain machine-unverified; Supporting Information association is unestablished.
